items.t: One navbar, a map with pictures, and every way into ORG
items.s: The lab now runs on ORG's kit 1.2. Every page has one navbar that never wraps (Lab, Changelog, Ledger, Map, the dApp preview, an ORG menu, Get involved and About, an icon on each), folding into a Menu button on smaller screens, with the same links in groups at the foot of each page. Reach out and Community open ORG's own windows: its addresses, Tripp, its CONTACTS.md, and its Telegram group. The map now shows every destination as a card with the picture its link shows, the lab and the dApp preview included, above the diagram, all drawn from ORG's one copy. New Roadmap and Sustainability pages say where the lab is headed and what keeps it running. Names read first name and last initial.

items.t: The dApp preview joins the suite
items.s: The dApp preview now runs on ORG's arrival kit, like this lab and ORG's own sites: the first-visit welcome, the light & motion controls, reading mode, contrast, cursor effects, the welcome guide, / to search, and a count of what's new here since your last visit. A strip at the top links straight to this changelog. The "three directions" showcase moved off its home page and into ORG's AstroLog, where Renan's proposal is kept as history; everything else about the dApp works as before.

items.t: A ledger of every public change, in plain words
items.s: A new Ledger page lists every public change to the lab and the dApp preview: tidied into a plain sentence, sorted by kind (look and feel, records, new things, behind the scenes…), grouped by day and site, and linked to the change itself. It's gathered from the public mirrors only and rebuilt every day, and the same daily rebuild redraws the map from ORG's latest copy. ORG's own repositories have their ledger in the ORG AstroLog.

items.t: Reading mode, and what's new since your last visit
items.s: The book button in the header is reading mode: one tap for Stone & Lapis, still ink, more contrast and no cursor trail, and another tap brings back what you had. Coming back later, a small count beside the search button shows lab entries and ledger changes that are new since your last visit, and opening it clears it.

items.t: Every entry gets its own page and preview card
items.s: Share one change and it arrives designed: each entry now has a page of its own, and a link to it shows that entry's title, summary and who made it in Telegram, iMessage or Discord. If Telegram shows an old preview, send the link to @WebpageBot to refresh it.

items.t: Choose how you arrive, here too
items.s: The lab now runs on ORG's arrival kit: a first-visit welcome, light, motion and contrast that carry over to the dApp preview, a welcome guide, and / to search this lab and ORG's AstroLog at once.

items.t: The sidecar becomes the drasticstatic ORG lab
items.s: This site is now the changelog and portfolio of what Christopher builds for ORG in his lab, starting with the dApp preview. ORG's own repositories have their official record in the ORG AstroLog. Every entry below stays here as history.

items.t: The dApp preview takes on all three lights
items.s: Living marble you can stir, an octagon made of the eight section artworks, the blotter sheet as a second view, and real belief tallies with agreement bars.
